name: Butter
overview: Scripture presents butter as a symbol of nourishment and blessing, often associated with abundance and God's provision, as seen in Genesis 18:8 where Abraham serves butter alongside milk and meat. The process of making butter through churning, highlighted in Proverbs 30:33, serves as a metaphor for spiritual truths, illustrating how pressure and effort produce results. Butter is also linked with wisdom and discernment in Isaiah 7:15, where its consumption is connected to the ability to choose good over evil.
